audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Sion, Sion, Skill, Skill, Sion, Sion while the whys under those rows say 'you own L1', 'you keep dodging his charged Q while chipping him down', 'you out-DPS his Soul Furnace shield'. Every row where the token says Sion, the text says Yone.
audit.why: The already-audited Sion side set the chart to Skill, Skill, Sion, Yone, Sion, Skill, Yone in both of its layers. Same tokens, same rows — the two pages must read identically, and mirror-fix.js would overwrite anything else. That reading is also the one the kit supports: level 3 is Sion's (Soul Furnace shield plus Roar of the Slayer's armour shred), 4-5 is Yone's, 6 is Sion's on a lane-crossing knockup, first item is even while he converts gold into health, and two items is Yone's.
audit.corrected: Set both layers to Skill, Skill, Sion, Yone, Sion, Skill, Yone and re-point every why at the same reading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appears, and the first-item row is written as a clean Yone spike.
audit.why: Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s, Soul Furnace 15/14/13/12/11s, Roar of the Slayer 12/11/10/9/8s and Unstoppable Onslaught 140/100/60s. The 140-second rank-1 ultimate is the single biggest number in the lane and the page never states it. Sion's first item also goes into health, which Soul Furnace then converts into shield — so the first-item row is not a one-sided Yone spike.
audit.corrected: Put 140s on Unstoppable Onslaught and 12s on Roar of the Slayer, and describe first item as the point where his health stacking meets your damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the player twice to 'dash out of' Unstoppable Onslaught with Soul Unbound and to combo Sion 'during the animation lock'. It also never mentions Roar of the Slayer's armour reduction or the minion knockback.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is not a dash and not an escape: Riot's text sends the spirit out with bonus Move Speed and then forces it back to the body Yone left behind. Using it to dodge a charge that Sion can steer means returning to a spot he already knows. The 'animation lock' after his ultimate is not in Riot's text and is not asserted here. What is in the text and missing from the page: Roar of the Slayer reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit, and if it hits a minion it knocks that minion back, damaging, slowing and shredding everything it passes through — so he can shove a caster minion into you from 800 range.
audit.corrected: Sidestep the charge on foot; Soul Unbound drags you back to your body. Respect Roar of the Slayer as an 800-range armour shred that can arrive off a knocked-back minion.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already core, which is right for the wrong stated reason: the healing is Glory in Death — after being killed Sion reanimates with rapid attacks that heal him and deal bonus damage based on your maximum health. Grievous Wounds is aimed at the corpse, not at lane sustain.

edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours: Q3 knockups burn through Soul Furnace faster than he can re-shield it every 15 seconds. At 6 that flips — Unstoppable Onslaught is steerable, crosses the whole lane and knocks you up, so hold ground you can sidestep on.

notes: Chart follows the already-written Sion side (Skill, Skill, Sion, Yone, Sion, Skill, Yone) rather than packet.levelChart, which reads Yone on six of seven rows. Both packets agree Yone is favoured overall (55.25% here, 48.13% on the Sion page), so the disagreement is about which stages, not who wins the lane — and the mirror's staging matches the kits. The most dangerous inherited line was 'hold your E (Soul Unbound) to dash out of its path': Soul Unbound is not a dash and forces a return to the body, so a player following it walks back into a charge Sion can steer. Sion Q's listed range of 10000 is a data artifact (the mirror flagged the same thing) and was not used. Grievous Wounds is correctly core but for Glory in Death, not for lane sustain — the itemisation text says 'his healing fights your pattern', which is vague enough to leave standing.
